segment.source: Renders an event's facts as a short specification — date, time, place, price, language, capacity — beside a picture, with the registration button underneath. Use it for: a workshop, a webinar, a conference day, an open evening, a training course, an annual general meeting. Prefer 'Waitlist Band' when the date is not fixed yet, and 'Demo Booking Band' when the appointment is one-to-one rather than a public event.
